thread:
maya roberts: Sycamore (channel partner) wants a joint POC with our Dedicated offering next week. Primary asks: EU data residency, SAML SSO, and an ops runbook for scaling to ~400k tokens/day. They also want an initial cost estimate and an answer to their security questionnaire.
tony li: TL;DR we can support SAML on Dedicated. Need tenant provisioning lead time: 72 hours after entitlements. For EU residency we'll provision in eu-west-1 Dedicated pool.
sarah vega: Pricing: give them two options — 30-day consumption cap at estimated usage and a 3-month committed tier with a modest discount. I'll draft numbers. Also confirm partner billing flow: will partner be billed or customer directly?
maya roberts: Partner prefers partner-managed billing for the co-sell pilot. Need to confirm revenue share later but for POC partner-pay is fine.
eng-oncall-bot: reminder: Dedicated tenant provisioning window can be delayed by infra maint. ETA ~72-96 hours depending on capacity.
ton y li: Network options: VPC peering preferred for low latency. If they choose egress, we'll need their egress IPs and a firewall test window. Provide both templates.
sarah vega: Security questionnaire highlights: KMS key ownership, retention policy, access logs. @legal-ops can you prefill standard answers and flag anything requiring escalation?
legal-ops: I'll handle the questionnaire. Quick notes: Customer-managed KMS supported in Private; for Dedicated we can integrate customer KMS with onboarding. Default audit log retention 90 days; extended retention needs addendum. Will update thread by EOD.
tony li: Ops runbook draft: 1) Entitlement + tenant provisioning (72h) 2) SAML metadata exchange 3) Network test (VPC peering walkthrough) 4) Perf baseline (10k, 100k, 400k day ramps) 5) Telemetry hook (route /sycamore-poc) 6) Spend cap and alerts 7) Canary traffic policy (5% first 24h). Need Eng SME signoff on #3 and #5.
maya roberts: Sycamore asks for a short enablement call (30m) Tuesday 15:00 UTC. Can ENG + sales join? Also want a quick demo of latency at 512-token prompts.
ton y li: I can join Tuesday. I'll bring a network checklist and suggested batching config to reduce token spend.
sarah vega: I'll bring the pricing slide and a sample SOW. For the SOW, if they opt into >90d log retention, include a note about add-on fees.
legal-ops: Questionnaire answers uploaded. Notable: encryption at rest supported; we need signed SOW for partner-managed billing terms.
maya roberts: Great. Action list: Tony tenant + SAML; Sarah pricing + SOW; Legal finalize billing terms. Reconvene Tue 15:00 UTC. Keeping this thread for artifacts. :white_check_mark:
